subject: AI tools for multifamily deal analysis?
body: Hey team — I run a small multifamily fund based in Phoenix and we're acquiring 5-15 properties per year. Right now our underwriting process is mostly spreadsheets and gut feel. I saw Compound Ventures is building AI tools for real estate investors. Would love to learn more about what you're working on and whether there's an early access program. We'd be happy to be a design partner if the fit is right. Our typical deal size is $2-8M and we focus on value-add Class B apartments in the Sun Belt.
